scope: Only hypothetical resident individuals with ordinary salary income using the prototype new-regime brackets, a ₹75,000 standard deduction, ₹12 lakh rebate threshold, and 4% cess. No special-rate income is modeled.

officialReferences.subject: Official Finance Bill 2026 FAQs, Q7-Q13, marginal relief examples and resident-individual restriction
Income Tax Department official new regime and 2026 rates

explicitAssumptions: residentIndividual must be explicitly true for Section 87A/202 rebate and marginal relief
Non-residents do not receive the rebate in the prototype API
Only regular salary income is included; no capital gains, lottery, crypto, business, other special-rate incomes
Cess of 4% is added after the rebate/marginal relief
Official FY 2026-27 statute, rounding conventions, filing status and other income-source applicability require full review before release
